Sheet.name: Name
Sheet.conceptHint: Concept: who they are, in a line
Sheet.armourHint: Worn armour soaks BODY damage from weapons (in brackets: against firearms).
Sheet.skillsHint: click a name to roll · a //Focus adds 20%

alien.culture: Among an alien culture (social or technical): Hard
alien.medicine: Medicine on an alien body: Very Hard
alien.strange: Strangeness 20-30, or an inventor's Soot under 50%: Hard

Luck.title: Luck
Luck.tooltip: Click a clover to spend Luck, a spent one to restore it. Red clovers are borrowed.
Luck.repayHint: Turn this success into a failure to repay a borrowed Luck Point
Luck.repaid: Borrowed Luck repaid: the success becomes a failure
Luck.once: Luck has already been used on this roll.

Oppose.noActor: Select a token or set your character first.
Oppose.title: Opposing: {title}
Oppose.tieText: Equal rolls: roll again, or let the moment pass.
Oppose.escalateHint: Turn it into an Extended Conflict

Damage.title: {name} loses {n} {pool}
Damage.zero: {name}'s {pool} is empty: they are out, unless they push on.
Damage.pushed: Below zero: every skill is −20% until it recovers, a point a day.
Damage.dead: {name} reaches their full negative value: a Comae State, and in this game perhaps death.
Damage.noTargets: Target the tokens to apply it to.
Damage.hazardHint: Damage from a fall, a fire, fear, hunger…

Rest.title: {name} sleeps
Rest.hint: A night's sleep: pools at zero or above refill; below zero, one point.

Scenario.hint: Luck renews (unless borrowed); Contacts and Labs answer again.
Scenario.title: {name}: the case closes

Creation.toggleHint: Show the skill pyramid while building the character
Creation.help: One skill at 50%, two at 30%, four more at 30%; the rest 5%. The starred places come with a Focus each (drop a career to fill them).
Creation.poolsHelp: Pools: give 16, 14, 12 and 10 to BODY, INT, POW and CHA (now {sum} in all), or roll 2d6+6 each.
Creation.rollPoolsText: Roll 2d6+6 for each of the four pools, replacing them?

Experience.rollsHint: Experience rolls to spend: 1d4+1 to one skill each.
Experience.bankedHint: Rolls forgone toward a new Focus (4) or Tag (6).
Experience.endSessionHint: An experience roll, and a second if a Willpower Focus was followed
Experience.followedHint: Acted for a Willpower Focus more often than not this session
Experience.bankHint: Put an experience roll aside toward a Focus or a Tag

Growth.upkeep1: Update the Peculiarities from what happened.
Growth.upkeep2: Should a Willpower Focus corrupt, deepen or change?
Growth.upkeep3: Adjust the Disposition of key Circle members.
Growth.upkeep4: Record any killings, and settle delayed deaths.

Focus.label: Focus
Focus.restrictedHint: Restricted Focuses (✱) cannot be taken at creation: The Soot, and spells.

Tag.label: Tag
Tag.none: No Tags yet. Two to begin with.
Tag.gmDecides: The organisation may answer: the Game Master decides how, and when.
Tag.usesHint: The next call has a {n}% chance.

Drive.hint: +20% to Willpower when acting for them
Drive.personNote: Who is it? Give them a name.
Drive.circleNote: From the Circle table. A positive Circle suggests Protect, Be Loyal to or Love; a negative one Fear, Hate, Hide from or Avenge.
Drive.corruptHint: Twist it (Corrupted Focus), or set it straight
Drive.corruptText: The Soot twists {phrase}. What does it become?
Drive.secondCircleHint: Background only: a Circle with no Willpower Focus, and perhaps an enemy

Soot.title: The Soot
Soot.cleanHelp: Taking a life risks infection: roll under POW's maximum.
Soot.infectedHelp: Every further killing tests The Soot: roll under it, and the Peculiarity table follows. At 100%, it takes the character.
Soot.killHint: Record a killing and test The Soot
Soot.killClean: {name} has taken a life. Roll under POW to see whether The Soot takes root?
Soot.killInfected: {name} has taken another life. Test The Soot?
Soot.infectedText: {name} is infected. The Soot starts at {pow}%.
Soot.stirsText: Something in {name} gives way. Roll on the Peculiarity table.
Soot.raiseNone: A Peculiarity would worsen, but there is none.
Soot.corruptNote: Choose a Willpower Focus to corrupt (the heart-crack button).
Soot.npcHint: Sets the tier, Code Block and Soot to the Phase's recipe.

Peculiarity.help: A showing Peculiarity lowers the skills it affects by its value; the roll dialog ticks it for you. Willpower is never lowered.
Peculiarity.sessionHint: Start of session: roll them, highest first, stopping at the first that shows
Peculiarity.temptHint: Tempted or under pressure: roll under it to give in
Peculiarity.defyHint: Defy it for the day (+20% to it); again, with Willpower
Peculiarity.defiedText: Held off for today; it stands at {value}% until tomorrow.
Peculiarity.treatHint: A month of treatment: roll over it
Peculiarity.treatText: {name}: two good months in a row lower it by 10% ({cost} kr a month).
Peculiarity.specHint: the phobia, obsession or body part

Magic.lockedHelp: Magic stays at 0% until the character has #Paranormal: a starting Tag, or granted with the first spell learned.
Magic.help: Magic alone is theory: reading fons mercurialis, judging a device's magic, learning spells. Casting needs the spell as a Focus: Magic + 20%.
Magic.needFocus: Casting needs the spell as its Focus.
Magic.tooLittle: {name} has too little POW ({n} needed) and cannot push past empty.
Magic.secret: The GM rolls in secret; always the full cost
Magic.pushed: POW is below zero: every skill −20%.
Magic.learnedText: A new Magic Focus. Magic stands at {n}%.
Magic.dropText: {name} has found {spell}. Learning it from the page is an Extended Conflict (Complexity {n}). As Game Master you may simply grant it.
Magic.studyHelp: Drop a spell from the Spells compendium on the sheet to study it from a written source.

Medicine.hint: //Medicine: 1d4 to a pool above zero, 1 below it
Medicine.title: Treating {name}
Medicine.notOwner: Only the patient's owner or the GM can apply it.

Career.help: Three skills fill the 50%*, 30%* and 30%* places of the pyramid, with a Focus each; then two Tags. Drop the career on an investigator.
Career.applyText: Set these skills and add their Focuses and Tags?

Npc.applyTierHint: Sets the pools and the three skills to the tier's values; the rest go to 5%.
Npc.rollAntagonist: Roll an antagonist's Code Block (with the Dark Triad)
Npc.dispositionHint: Disposition is added to the characters' social rolls against this NPC when it is targeted.

Conflict.title: Extended Conflict
Conflict.gmOnly: Only the Game Master starts a conflict.
Conflict.name: Name
Conflict.candidatesHint: Selected tokens come first. Drop more actors on the board later.
Conflict.obstacleHint: A lock, a storm, a manuscript, a dinner party: its pool is how long it takes, its rating how hard it is.
Conflict.clueAt: A clue when the pool falls to {n}
Conflict.beginText: Each side describes what it attempts, highest pool first; then everyone rolls on the board.
Conflict.pushingHint: Pushing on below zero: every skill −20%
Conflict.cleverHint: Won with Clever: next round +20%, or damage rolled twice
Conflict.cleverDouble: Roll damage twice, keep the higher
Conflict.endText: End this conflict? Pools stay as they are.
Conflict.boardHint: Drop actors here to add them. ±20 nudges a participant's next roll.
Conflict.pushHint: Press on below zero: −20% to everything, at the risk of a Comae State
Conflict.cannotPush: Common and Skilled NPCs cannot push.
Conflict.pushText: Below zero now: every skill −20%, and recovery is slow.
Conflict.targetPoolHint: Covert may strike any pool; Flamboyant the main pool or CHA.
Conflict.cleverWin: {name} wins Cleverly: no damage now, an advantage next round.
Conflict.quick: {name} has a second action (not an attack).
Conflict.learnFailed: The text resists. Try again in a month.
Conflict.pushedAfter: Pushed pools now recover one point a day.

Migration.start: Odd Soot (Comae): bringing {n} actor(s) up to version 2…

lenses.name: Lenses
lenses.hint: Offer the Lenses (Aggressive, Cautious, Clever, Covert, Flamboyant, Quick) in Extended Conflicts.

halving.name: Halved pools are Hard
halving.hint: Odd Soot's rule: a pool at half or less makes its conflict rolls −20%. The Comae Engine has no such rule.

negativeLuck.name: Negative Luck
negativeLuck.hint: Characters may borrow Luck down to −2, repaying each point by turning a success into a failure.

lethal.name: Lethal end game
lethal.hint: A pool at its full negative value may mean death. Off: a Comae State only takes the character out of the scenario.

corruption.name: Corruption (house rule)
corruption.hint: An infected caster's exceptional failure tests The Soot as a killing would.

Gear.name: Name
Gear.attackHint: Roll Combat with it (and its Focus)
Gear.apFirearmsHint: Bullet-proof: armour against firearms (0 if the same)

Enricher.check: Roll this check (your character, or a controlled token)
